introHtml: Faux leather cables and cords offer a sophisticated alternative to standard nylon or polyester options. The soft, textured finish mimics real leather without the cost or maintenance, making them ideal for premium lanyards, badge holders, and keychains at corporate events or trade shows. These cords hold up well to daily use while adding a touch of elegance to your branded accessories. Choose from multiple colors and customize with screen printing or debossing for a polished look.
